 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Krishn Murari, Adv.
 Mr. Md. Kamaluddin, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Rishi Raj Sinha (Sc-19)
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Shailendra Singh
 Oral Order

3 04-09-2025 The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners under section 226 of the Constitution of India, invoking the writ jurisdiction of this Court, for directing the respondents to pay adequate compensation amount in respect of the petitioners' land, which has been acquired for the construction of Koelwar Bridge.

2. After hearing the petitioners' counsel and learned counsel appearing for the State-respondents,
this Court finds that the petitioners should have filed an application before the Patna High Court CWJC No.17004 of 2021(3) dt.04-09-2025 Collector, Bhojpur at Ara (respondent No. 2), under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for redressal of their grievance with regard to the determination of the proper compensation amount in respect of their acquired land but the petitioners, without availing Kalawati Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102779610/
1 the said remedy, directly approached this Court by filing this writ petition.

3. Considering this aspect, the instant writ petition stands disposed of, with giving a liberty to the petitioners to file an application before the Collector, Bhojpur at Ara (respondent No. 2), for the aforesaid purpose in the next four weeks and if they avail this liberty then the Collector shall proceed with the application in the light of the provisions of section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
4.
